headline: Recommended approval of a truck ban on Hamilton St. and Lake Ave., and a handicap parking space at 4 Hartshorn Ave.
summary: Recommended approval of a truck ban and weight restriction for Hamilton St. and Lake Ave., handicap parking spaces, and bus stops on Constitution Ave. Other requests were recommended for filing or for a hold. A chairman's order asked the City Manager to have advanced signage installed on Byron St.
